non_idle_rule: After every result or interruption, immediately analyze, log, and launch the next experiment. The watchdog recovers only declared queued workers. When the queue is empty, the primary Codex process must plan and enqueue the next experiments. Wait only for an active process, active Codex planning, or required external operation. Stop only on exact top-level STOP.
current_hypothesis: The fixed 95/5 leader-plus-regularized blend reached 0.557229 test accuracy and 0.556975 test macro F1, below the single leader. A final fixed 90/10 blend tests whether a larger midpoint-decay contribution changes the error mixture. The weight is fixed before evaluation.
experiment_queue: Run one cheap encoder-only alternative on the fixed clean split.
Run one additional Jina encoder training variant with a distinct mechanism.
Evaluate a small seed ensemble of the strongest encoder checkpoints.
Evaluate calibrated logit blending between the strongest encoder and Qwen candidates.
Evaluate a confidence-based encoder versus Qwen gate if blending shows complementary errors.
Evaluate a training-only learned stacker if the gate or blend shows signal.
Explore deeper variants only after these breadth-first probes produce evidence.
